scope: Actual PanelForge voice components and server pipeline in an isolated wrapper, using fictional file-backed input and real provider responses.

recording.origin: Stock eSpeak en-gb machine speech recorded by Chromium MediaRecorder from a file-backed fake device.
recording.recognizedTextRaw: For an imaginary moon garden, name one blue flower. Answer in one short sentence.
recording.recognizedTextDisplay: For an imaginary moon garden, name one blue flower. Answer in one short sentence.
recording.displayNormalization: Only surrounding whitespace removed for display. Raw recognized value retained above.
recording.conversion: Decoded actual uploaded WebM/Opus and resampled mono 48 kHz to mono 24 kHz PCM 16-bit WAV. No cuts, speed change or volume normalization. Converted bytes differ from the upload.

method.privateToolRestriction: Empty SDK toolset, empty MCP selection and deny-every-tool hook.
method.limits: One SDK turn; model budget $0.50; configured 160-token output cap; independent 240-second whole-run watchdog.

limits: One final chunk; not an out-of-order multi-chunk proof.
Media completion is not evidence of human audibility or physical speaker routing.
File-backed input is not a physical microphone or iOS/Safari test.
Provider HTTP/billing totals were not inferred from model turns or transport connections.
The portfolio serves saved files only and connects to no microphone or provider.
